title: Bali in 60 seconds ✈️🌿
description:
POV: you chose Bali and you'd do it again 🌴

Spent 10 days island hopping and I'm obsessed. Here's everything we did:

📍 Ubud Monkey Forest — feed the monkeys (carefully!)
📍 Tegallalang Rice Terraces at sunrise
📍 Tirta Empul Temple — the water purification ceremony is unreal
📍 Mount Batur — woke up at 2am for this sunrise hike, worth every minute
📍 Nusa Penida — Crystal Bay for snorkeling, Kelingking Beach for views
📍 Seminyak Beach for sunsets and cocktails
📍 Tanah Lot Temple at sunset (get there early!)

Full vlog on YouTube — link in bio 🎬
